signal: Connected2Fiber (now Connectbase) acquired Cloud Age in December 2025 and took a strategic PE investment to expand its Connected World platform

email.body1:
Elizabeth, saw Connected2Fiber acquired Cloud Age and took a strategic investment to expand the Connected World platform.

Folding in a new product usually widens the gap between the signals hitting your stack and the team acting on them, so good accounts cool off before anyone reaches out. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, turning signal into booked meetings: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

I built a personalized signal play for Connected2Fiber off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Elizabeth, quick follow-up for Connected2Fiber.

As ops, you feel signal-to-action latency most: leads land, but research, writing, and CRM logging slow the response and the lift never quite shows up in the numbers. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change, then show how the measurable lift maps to your funnel. A quick call is all it takes.
email.body3:
Elizabeth, last bit of proof for Connected2Fiber.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. With our AI SDR they reached $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage B2B platforms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Elizabeth, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after an acquisition, I know integrating Cloud Age keeps ops busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion? I will tailor it to Connected2Fiber either way.
